newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Lujiazui '96 net up 51.41 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Lujiazui '96 net up 51.41 pct.

text.p: Year ended December 31, 1996 (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net asset per share 2.84 yuan vs 2.74 yuan
Earnings per share 0.47 yuan vs 0.80 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co Ltd
Note: the company published its annual results in a statement on Thursday.
The 1996 net profit, given by a company spokesman, and the 1995 net figure are based on international accounting standards. Other figures are based on domestic standards.

Based on domestic accounting standards, the net profit was 623.714 million yuan for 1996 against 584.514 million yuan for 1995, the statement said. The earnings per share figures are on a fully diluted basis, the statement said.
The company's board of directors proposed no end-year distribution of profits due to heavy returns to investors in the middle of 1996, the statement said.
The proposal requires appproval of shareholders at the 1996 annual meeting to be held at a later date, the statement said.
